project_context.summary: Master bathroom remodel on the Mountaineer House. The jetted tub came out and became a walk in shower with a lit niche and glass hooks through the door, the old cramped shower became a linen cabinet, and the floating vanity picked up under lighting, a hidden USB drawer, and a wired in makeup mirror. The tile floor is heated.
project_context.segment_choice: One Short, a reveal tour. It opens on four seconds of the dated vanity so the viewer has a before to measure against, then spends the rest of its runtime in the finished room, naming one upgrade per beat.
notes: Every beat after the hook plays over finished house footage.
Nothing in the Short shows demo, workers, or price.

shorts.full_vo: This master bathroom went from dated to a total showpiece. They love mountain climbing, so the whole bath was built around red rock colors. And we completely transformed it. We tore out the old jetted tub and turned that whole space into the shower. The shower is the star. The homeowner fell in love with the tile, paired with a complementary marble, grain matched so it flows down the wall and across the threshold. Inside the niche, an LED strip light running all the way across, plus glass hooks that go right through the shower door. The floating vanity has LED mood lighting underneath, a hidden USB outlet in the drawer for hair dryers, and a magnifying makeup mirror wired right in. And the whole tile floor is heated, with a programmable thermostat. No more cold feet. And where the old cramped shower was, there is now full linen storage.
shorts.voice_direction: Warm and unhurried, a contractor walking a friend through the finished room. Plain delivery, no announcer push. Let the features do the work.
